017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.arg;
018
019import java.lang.reflect.*;
020import java.util.*;
021
022import org.apache.juneau.commons.httppart.*;
023import org.apache.juneau.httppart.bean.*;
024
025/**
026 * Resolves and caches the public no-arg constructor and per-getter setter {@link Method}s for a concrete
027 * (non-interface) {@link org.apache.juneau.http.Request @Request} bean class.
028 *
029 * <p>
030 * {@link RequestBeanArg} resolves one of these once, when the {@code @RestOp} is registered (servlet init), instead of the historical per-request {@code Class.getMethod} lookup in
031 * {@code RestRequest.newRequestBean}. A getter with no matching setter, or a bean with no public no-arg constructor,
032 * now fails registration with an {@link IllegalArgumentException} naming the bean, the getter and the expected setter
033 * &mdash; not only the requests that happen to supply that parameter.
034 *
035 * <h5 class='section'>Example:</h5>
036 * <p class='bjava'>
037 *    <jc>// A concrete request bean: public no-arg constructor plus a setter for every annotated getter.</jc>
038 *    <ja>@Request</ja>
039 *    <jk>public class</jk> MyQuery {
040 *       <jk>private</jk> String <jf>foo</jf>;
041 *       <ja>@Query</ja> <jk>public</jk> String getFoo() { <jk>return</jk> <jf>foo</jf>; }
042 *       <jk>public void</jk> setFoo(String <jv>value</jv>) { <jf>foo</jf> = <jv>value</jv>; }
043 *    }
044 *
045 *    RequestBeanMeta <jv>meta</jv> = RequestBeanMeta.<jsm>create</jsm>(MyQuery.<jk>class</jk>, <jv>annotations</jv>);
046 *    RequestBeanSetters <jv>setters</jv> = RequestBeanSetters.<jsm>resolve</jsm>(MyQuery.<jk>class</jk>, <jv>meta</jv>);
047 *    MyQuery <jv>bean</jv> = <jv>setters</jv>.newInstance();
048 *    <jv>setters</jv>.set(<jv>bean</jv>, <jv>meta</jv>.getProperty(<js>"getFoo"</js>).getGetter(), <js>"value"</js>);
049 * </p>
050 *
051 * @since 10.0.0
052 */
053public final class RequestBeanSetters {
054
055   private static final Map<HttpPartType,String> ANNOTATION_NAMES = Map.of(
056      HttpPartType.HEADER, "@Header",
057      HttpPartType.QUERY, "@Query",
058      HttpPartType.FORMDATA, "@FormData",
059      HttpPartType.PATH, "@Path",
060      HttpPartType.BODY, "@Content"
061   );
062
063   /**
064    * Resolves the constructor and setters for a concrete {@link org.apache.juneau.http.Request @Request} bean class.
065    *
066    * @param beanClass The bean class. Must not be an interface.
067    * @param meta The metadata gathered from the class's annotated getters. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
068    * @return A new {@link RequestBeanSetters}.
069    * @throws IllegalArgumentException If {@code beanClass} has no public no-arg constructor, or if any annotated
070    *    getter has no matching setter.
071    */
072   public static RequestBeanSetters resolve(Class<?> beanClass, RequestBeanMeta meta) {
073      Constructor<?> ctor;
074      try {
075         ctor = beanClass.getConstructor();
076      } catch (NoSuchMethodException e) {
077         throw new IllegalArgumentException(
078            String.format("Request bean %s must have a public no-arg constructor.", beanClass.getName()));
079      }
080      var setters = new LinkedHashMap<String,Method>();
081      for (var pm : meta.getProperties()) {
082         var getter = pm.getGetter();
083         var setterName = "set" + getter.getName().substring(getter.getName().startsWith("is") ? 2 : 3);
084         try {
085            setters.put(getter.getName(), beanClass.getMethod(setterName, getter.getReturnType()));
086         } catch (NoSuchMethodException e) {
087            throw new IllegalArgumentException(
088               String.format("Request bean %s has %s getter %s() with no matching setter %s(%s).",
089                  beanClass.getName(), ANNOTATION_NAMES.getOrDefault(pm.getPartType(), "@" + pm.getPartType()), getter.getName(), setterName,
090                  getter.getReturnType().getSimpleName()));
091         }
092      }
093      return new RequestBeanSetters(ctor, setters);
094   }
095
096   private final Constructor<?> ctor;
097   private final Map<String,Method> setters;
098
099   private RequestBeanSetters(Constructor<?> ctor, Map<String,Method> setters) {
100      this.ctor = ctor;
101      this.setters = setters;
102   }
103
104   /**
105    * Instantiates the bean via its public no-arg constructor.
106    *
107    * @param <T> The bean type.
108    * @return A new, empty bean instance.
109    * @throws ReflectiveOperationException If instantiation fails.
110    */
111   @SuppressWarnings({
112      "unchecked" // newInstance() casts the constructed bean to the caller's T.
113   })
114   public <T> T newInstance() throws ReflectiveOperationException {
115      return (T)ctor.newInstance();
116   }
117
118   /**
119    * Invokes the setter matching the specified getter on the specified bean.
120    *
121    * @param bean The bean to populate. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
122    * @param getter The getter identifying the property, as returned by {@link RequestBeanPropertyMeta#getGetter()}.
123    * @param value The value to set. Callers skip absent (<jk>null</jk>) values rather than passing them here.
124    * @throws ReflectiveOperationException If the setter invocation fails.
125    */
126   public void set(Object bean, Method getter, Object value) throws ReflectiveOperationException {
127      setters.get(getter.getName()).invoke(bean, value);
128   }
129}
